_comment: Settings of the LV screening. Paths are relative to this folder; scenarios come from ../injection-scenarios/output/<name>.
_demand_factor_comment: Planning demand of every connection as a fraction of its fuse-rated peak (DSO value, 6 %). Used by the one-shot snapshot; scenarios carry their own copy.

oneshot._comment: Snapshot of the data sanity check: demand_factor x fuse-rated peak at every connection at the same instant, plus generation_factor x existing PV.
